method.pairing: Same camera mode and round, delta = A segment render median minus B segment render median. Pair segments, never unrelated frame indexes; each segment retains all its frames. Warmup routes are separate and excluded from the 5 paired rounds.
method.quartiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p for Q1/median/Q3; IQR=Q3-Q1. Paired-delta IQR describes five round differences; segment IQR describes each segment frame distribution.
method.slowThreshold: Frame RAF interval >22ms, unchanged from driver.
method.time: nowMs and preparation states use page performance.now milliseconds; relative to document time origin, not elapsed time since diagnostic segment.
method.verification: Recomputed every segment render median/Q1/Q3/IQR and slow-frame count from saved frames; all exactly match the report.
method.limits: No GPU timer/CPU trace/thermal/OS telemetry. Resource counts count tracked objects, not bytes, uploads, compiles, GPU time, or object identities. Warmup snapshots bound growth timing without per-frame evidence during stationary preparation. Fixed A-then-B order, moving animation and scene history remain confounders; no new causal mechanism is established.

conclusions.claim: Paired render median deltas are usually positive but reverse sign in 2/5 rounds in each mode; do not treat them as a proven steady-state city cost.
conclusions.numbers: A-B median deltas (ms): third [0.80,-0.75,-0.60,2.50,0.65], median=0.65, Q1=-0.60,Q3=0.80,IQR=1.40; first [1.10,-0.15,1.60,-0.50,5.00], median=1.10,Q1=-0.15,Q3=1.60,IQR=1.75. Segment IQRs are separately retained for A and B in pairs; these paired-delta quartiles are descriptive across 5 rounds, not confidence intervals.

conclusions.claim: Observed resource-count growth does not coincide consistently with slow frames; counts alone cannot identify an environmental cause or exclude other resource work.
conclusions.numbers: Programs=107 and textures=232 throughout all 4250 recorded frames. Geometries grow during stationary preparations 1062→1072 (36.006–37.529s),1072→1073 (45.209–46.731s),1073→1074 (63.654–65.160s),1075→1076 (86.684–88.206s); precise intra-preparation moments are unavailable. The sole sampled increment is third-A4 frame136 at 71.9324s,1074→1075,frame=15.4ms,render=12.7ms; its whole segment has zero >22ms frames. Slow frames total49, including18 in hidden third-B3 and18 in visible first-A5, all with fixed in-segment resource counts.

conclusions.claim: A submits more geometry in every pair, but changing non-isolated scene work and fixed ordering confound subtraction.
conclusions.numbers: A-B per-frame mean draw differences span33.44–57.84; triangle differences21,194.84–185,119.26. Several pairs are near43 draws/95k triangles, but third round3 and first round2 differ substantially. This is full-scene accounting, not a direct city-only counter. All recorded renderer.info.autoReset values are false, and calls/triangles match separately wrapped all-pass counters exactly in all4250 frames. A/B switches city connections/foundations as well as the three buildings; animation/time and runtime history continue.
